Bearing Fits — Shaft and Housing Tolerance Classes

2026-11-14
en.<p>베어링을 축과 하우징에 끼울 때 고르는 공차 등급(k5 · m5 ·: This notice summarizes the tolerance classes (k5 · m5 · H7, etc.) chosen when fitting a bearing onto a shaft and into a housing. It applies to normal-class (class 0) radial bearings, solid steel shafts, and cast-iron or steel housings.
en.① 어느 쪽을 단단하게 끼우나: ① Which ring gets the tight fit
en.내륜이 돌고 하중 방향은 일정: Inner ring rotates, load direction fixed
en.억지 끼워맞춤 (k · m · n · p · r): Interference fit (k · m · n · p · r)
en.헐거운 끼워맞춤 가능 (F · G · H · JS): Clearance fit acceptable (F · G · H · JS)
en.외륜이 돌고 하중 방향은 일정: Outer ring rotates, load direction fixed
en.헐거운 끼워맞춤 가능 (f · g · h · js): Clearance fit acceptable (f · g · h · js)
en.고정 축에 도는 바퀴 · 풀리: Wheels · pulleys turning on a fixed shaft

en.하중을 받으며 도는 링을 헐겁게 끼우면 링이 축 · 하우징 위에서 미끄러: If a ring that rotates relative to the load is fitted loosely, it slips around on the shaft or housing (creep), causing heat and wear.
en.불평형 하중처럼 하중이 링과 함께 돌면 반대로 봅니다. 예: 내륜이 돌고: If the load rotates together with a ring, as with an unbalanced load, the case is reversed. e.g. inner ring and load rotating together = rotating outer ring load
en.소문자(k5 등) = 축 공차, 대문자(H7 등) = 하우징 구멍 공차입: Lowercase (k5, etc.) = shaft tolerance; uppercase (H7, etc.) = housing bore tolerance.
en.② 축 공차 — 레이디얼 베어링 (원통 구멍): ② Shaft tolerances — radial bearings (cylindrical bore)
en.외륜 회전 하중 (내륜이 축 위에서 쉽게 움직여야 함): Rotating outer ring load (inner ring must move easily on the shaft)
en.외륜 회전 하중 (내륜이 움직일 필요 없음): Rotating outer ring load (inner ring need not move)
en.내륜 회전 하중 · 방향 부정 — 가벼운 하중: Rotating inner ring or indeterminate load — light load
en.내륜 회전 하중 · 방향 부정 — 보통 하중: Rotating inner ring or indeterminate load — normal load
en.내륜 회전 하중 · 방향 부정 — 무거운 하중 · 충격: Rotating inner ring or indeterminate load — heavy · shock load
en.축 지름 단위 mm. 18~100 = 18 초과 100 이하, ~18 =: Shaft diameters in mm. 18~100 = over 18 up to 100, ~18 = up to 18, 200~ = over 200
en.하중 구분(P = 동등가 레이디얼 하중, Cr = 기본 동정격하중): 가: Load classes (P = dynamic equivalent radial load, Cr = basic dynamic load rating): light = P ≤ 0.05Cr, normal = 0.05~0.10Cr, heavy = over 0.10Cr. The boundaries differ slightly by maker.
en.단열 테이퍼 롤러 · 단열 앵귤러 볼 베어링은 k5 · m5 대신 k6: For single-row tapered roller and single-row angular contact ball bearings, k6 · m6 may be used instead of k5 · m5.
Under heavy loads, use bearings with internal clearance larger than CN (C3, etc.).
en.속이 빈 축 · 얇은 하우징 · 진동이 큰 곳은 표보다 더 단단하게 끼웁: For hollow shafts, thin housings, or heavy vibration, use a tighter fit than the table.
en.외륜 정지 (내륜 회전 하중): Stationary outer ring (rotating inner ring load)
en.얇은 하우징 + 무거운 하중 · 큰 충격: Thin housing + heavy load · heavy shock
en.외륜을 단단하게 끼우는 경우(K7 · M7 · N7 · P7)는 분할 하: When the outer ring is fitted tightly (K7 · M7 · N7 · P7), use a solid housing rather than a split housing.
Light-alloy housings such as aluminum need a tighter fit than the table.
en.정밀 회전이 필요하면 JS6 · K6, 소음을 줄여야 하면 H6을 씁니다: Use JS6 · K6 where accurate running is required, and H6 where low noise is required.
en.어댑터 · 분리 슬리브(테이퍼 구멍 베어링): 축 h9 (진원도 · 원통: Adapter · withdrawal sleeves (tapered-bore bearings): shaft h9 (roundness · cylindricity IT5); h10 (IT7) for transmission shafts, etc.
en.스러스트 베어링 축: 축 방향 하중만 → h6 · js6: Thrust bearing shaft: axial load only → h6 · js6
en.자동조심 스러스트 롤러 베어링 축: 내륜 정지 → js6 / 내륜 회전: Spherical thrust roller bearing shaft: stationary inner ring → js6 / rotating inner ring or indeterminate → up to 200 k6, 200~400 m6, over 400 n6
en.스러스트 베어링 하우징: 축 방향 하중만 → 외륜과 하우징 사이에 지름: Thrust bearing housing: axial load only → leave radial clearance between the outer ring and housing. H8 for thrust ball bearings requiring accuracy
en.자동조심 스러스트 롤러 베어링 하우징: 외륜 정지 → H7 / 외륜 회전: Spherical thrust roller bearing housing: stationary outer ring → H7 / rotating outer ring or indeterminate → K7, M7 for relatively large radial loads
